items.question: What age range of juniors can take part in EmiratesSkills skills competitions in the UAE?
items.fact: EmiratesSkills competitions include juniors aged 12 to 15

items.question: Which body is EmiratesSkills, the UAE youth technical skills initiative, an initiative of?
items.gold: Abu Dhabi Centre for Technical and Vocational Education and Training (ACTVET).
items.fact: EmiratesSkills is an initiative of ACTVET
